program.name: Swing Athlete
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: Jumps, then one kettlebell: swings and cleans one day, presses and lunges the next, then balance.
program.about: Athletic power from one kettlebell. Each day opens with jumps; then the bell, swings, cleans and snatches one day, presses, rows and lunges the next. A balance circuit finishes every session. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
program.split: Jumps & bell ballistics / jumps & bell strength
